package.name: hhros2_interfaces
package.description: Unified global interface package for the humanoid platform (00_infrastructure). Defines the joint command/feedback message, floating-base state estimate, control-mode / system services, high-level locomotion / motion actions, and the system-governance messages (safety status, system health, heartbeat, arbitration mode) used by hhros2_core. This is the canonical ROS contract shared across platform layers.
